faqs.question: What types of companies can Al-Mazrouei help incorporate in Dubai?
faqs.answer: We handle LLCs, sole establishments, civil companies, branch offices, representative offices, and free zone entities (FZE/FZC) across all major UAE free zones including DMCC, DIFC, JAFZA, and DAFZA.

faqs.question: Do you handle cases in both Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes. All our attorneys are bilingual. Court submissions are prepared in Arabic (required by UAE courts), while client communications and documentation can be provided in English or Arabic per your preference.

faqs.question: How long does company incorporation take in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Mainland LLC incorporation typically takes 5-10 working days. Free zone companies can be incorporated in as little as 3-5 working days, depending on the authority and license type.

faqs.question: What are your legal fees for corporate services?
faqs.answer: We offer transparent fixed-fee packages. Incorporation services start from AED [X], litigation retainers are structured per case complexity. We provide a detailed fee estimate during the initial consultation.

faqs.question: Can you represent us in DIFC Courts?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have extensive experience before DIFC Courts for commercial disputes, and we regularly coordinate with DIFC-registered advocates when required for complex multi-jurisdictional matters.

faqs.question: Do you offer retainer services for ongoing corporate legal support?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monthly and quarterly retainer packages are available for businesses requiring ongoing compliance monitoring, contract review, employment advisory, and regulatory updates.

faqs.question: Do you accept new patients without insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes. We welcome all patients regardless of insurance status. We offer transparent self-pay rates and 0% installment plans for major treatments. New patient consultations including X-rays are completely free.

faqs.question: How do I book an emergency dental appointment?
faqs.answer: Call us directly or send a WhatsApp message. We hold daily emergency slots and will see you within hours for severe pain, swelling, broken teeth, or dental trauma. Do not wait — prompt treatment often saves the tooth.

faqs.question: Is teeth whitening safe? Does it hurt?
faqs.answer: Professional in-office whitening is completely safe when performed by a licensed dentist. We use gum barrier protection and professional-grade gel. Most patients experience zero pain. Temporary sensitivity is rare and resolves within 24 hours.

faqs.question: How long do dental implants last?
faqs.answer: With proper oral hygiene and regular check-ups, dental implants can last 25+ years or even a lifetime. The implant post fuses with your jawbone (osseointegration) creating a permanent, stable foundation. We provide a warranty on all implant procedures.

faqs.question: Do you treat children? At what age should a child first see a dentist?
faqs.answer: Yes, we love our young patients. The American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry recommends a first dental visit by age 1 or within 6 months of the first tooth appearing. We make it fun with a gentle, no-pressure introduction to the dental chair.

faqs.question: Which insurance networks are you part of?
faqs.answer: We are in-network with Daman, AXA, MetLife, Neuron, NAS, NextCare, and most major UAE insurance providers. Our team verifies your coverage before treatment begins so there are no surprise bills.

faqs.question: What COVID / infection control protocols do you follow?
faqs.answer: We follow strict Dubai Health Authority (DHA) sterilization and infection control protocols. All instruments are autoclave-sterilized, treatment rooms are disinfected between patients, and our team wears full PPE. Your safety is non-negotiable.
